Social Butterfly and Shambala impressed when the horses were exercised here on Tuesday (Oct. 20) morning.
600m: Admirable (N.B. Kuldeep) 42. Easy. Destroyer (Mosin) 39. Moved freely.
800m: Shambala (T.S. Jodha) 51, 600/38. Moved nicely. Believe (app), Victorious Omen (app) 56, 600/41. Pair level. Don Julio (Gore) 55, 600/42. Easy. Break Point (S. Kamble) 57, 600/42. Easy. Flash Mob (Zameer) 56, 600/42. Easy.
1000m: Elysium (Ramswarup) 1-8, 800/53, 600/40. Moved well. Social Butterfly (Mosin), Irish Gold (Gore) 1-4, 800/51, 600/39. Former moved impressively and they finished level.
